svg.aria-label: High level architecture: Contoso demo CSVs or a client's export arrive as data/input/sales_flat.csv (35 columns, 2,098,633 rows); the notebook maps 11 columns into output/sales.csv and writes the check numbers; Power Query types them and builds 3 tables; the data model is a star of 1 fact and 3 dimensions with a DAX Date table; 10 DAX measures; the fixed and slow report pages and the check numbers in powerbi/06-checks.md.
